verified_facts.text: Grand Hyatt Manila is at 8th Avenue corner 35th Street in Bonifacio Global City, Taguig City.
verified_facts.excerpt: 8th Avenue corner 35th Street, Bonifacio Global City, Taguig City, Manila, 1635, Philippines

verified_facts.text: The Grand Club lounge is on the 57th floor, with views over the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 57th floor of one of the highest skyscrapers in Manila, the Grand Club provides unparalleled city views of the metro.

verified_facts.text: Guests with Grand Club access enjoy all-day refreshments and complimentary one-hour use of the boardroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests with exclusive suite and club floor access can enjoy a wide range of amenities, from all-day refreshments to complimentary one-hour use of the boardroom.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites feature honeyed wood paneling, maple hardwood floors and gray-white marble bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: are adorned with honeyed wood paneling, maple hardwood floors, pristine richly veined gray-white marble bathrooms that have a separate toilet area

verified_facts.text: All accommodations have a walk-in closet and floor-to-ceiling windows with city skyline views.
verified_facts.excerpt: All of our accommodations also feature a spacious walk-in closet and huge floor-to-ceiling picturesque windows that provide a breathtaking view of the city skyline.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite takes up a quarter of an entire floor and has a dining area, living room and functioning kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Encompassing a quarter of an entire floor, the 301-square-meter suite (3,240 square feet) boasts an intimate receiving space, an exquisite dining area, a spacious living room and a functioning kitchen.

verified_facts.text: Grand Suites sit at the corner of each floor, with panoramic city views through floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: ideally located at the corner of each floor, providing a panoramic view of the city with its floor-to-ceiling windows

verified_facts.text: The Two-Bedroom Grand Suite is designed for families or groups, with a second room with twin beds and two bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxuriate with the privilege of space in this fabulous two-bedroom suite fashioned with the intent to accommodate families or groups.

verified_facts.text: The heated outdoor pool is on the 6th floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxuriate in an urban oasis on the 6th floor of Grand Hyatt Manila. Step outdoors for a dip in the heated pool amidst the vibrant city of Taguig.

verified_facts.text: Illume Spa offers treatments blending culture and indigenous traditions with the latest science and technology, in private treatment rooms with ensuite bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Illume Spa offers relaxing treatments that blend culture and indigenous traditions with the latest science and technology—all conducted in private treatment rooms with ensuite bathrooms.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours, with a personal trainer available on-site.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our 24-hour fitness center will keep you on top of your game with high-tech cardio and strengthening equipment, a customized fitness plan and a personal trainer available on-site.

verified_facts.text: The Magic Table, on the 66th floor at Penthouse No. 66, is an immersive dining experience created with The Clairvoyants where magic unfolds course by course.
verified_facts.excerpt: High above the city on the 66th floor, The Magic Table is an intimate, immersive dining spectacle where illusion reveals itself course by course. In collaboration with The Clairvoyants,

verified_facts.text: The Peak combines a grill restaurant, speakeasy, whisky bar and music lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: A beautiful collision of a grill restaurant, speakeasy, whisky bar, and a music lounge, The Peak will take you from dining, to drinks, to an exceptional experience of the high life.

verified_facts.text: No. 8 China House serves Chinese specialties such as Peking Duck and homemade dim sum prepared at cooking stations.
verified_facts.excerpt: best-loved Chinese specialties including Peking Duck, Chinese BBQ, Homemade Dim Sum and Cantonese seafood, all prepared before your eyes in several cooking stations

verified_facts.text: Mitsukoshi Mall is 0.18 miles from the hotel.
Manila Ninoy Aquino International Airport is 8 miles away.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers 2,281 square meters of event space across multiple floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Manila offers 2,281 square meters of space across multiple floors, making it a beautiful place to host events of all sizes.
